scope: Every tracked v28 blob inventoried from Git object bytes. Current uncommitted edits by other owners are outside this baseline; no source mutation or publication by reviewer.

decision_semantics.keep: Eligible to retain in the reviewed private revision and a later separately authorized, properly licensed curated public release; not authorization to publish now.
decision_semantics.generalize: Make an explicit non-destructive documentation/inventory revision; preserve baseline. This does not demand removing every case label or hash.
decision_semantics.omit: Exclude protected genomic payloads from public selection. No tracked baseline file was assigned this category; external generated artifacts remain excluded.
decision_semantics.block: A concrete unresolved release condition; here the license/scope declaration. Not a categorical ban on the underlying code.

interpretation_limits: KEEP guidance expressly names HPO and limited findings; sample labels, input hashes and hostname paths are assessed here by their content and non-reconstructive role, not by an explicit category-specific organizer ruling.
